cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: For Stability’s Sake
cards.instruction: Hide a destabilizing truth because you believe the current balance of power must be protected.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll keep the fair opening steady. Leave the treasurer's page out of the briefing; the chair needs everyone behind her.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She spent the stall money on that arch. They'll demand a new chair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll describe the arch as donated for now. You choose the briefing words; I don't want the committee splitting before we open.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll cover the money, but she signs my IOU before I pay a penny.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before payment, agreed. Pick a quiet table behind the stalls and I'll bring her to you. Then she gives the welcome as chair. We can meet your terms without handing anyone a reason to replace her.

reason: Have A accept B exact before-payment condition and practical location control while arranging concealment to protect the existing chair from displacement.
